transcript.text: someone sideswiped my car the other night on Main St and took off
Hi, I'm Sam, Wattle's AI claims assistant, and you can talk to a person at any time. Sorry to hear about the accident. I'll help you lodge the claim. First, is anyone hurt or in danger?
Not that I can tell, Sam. Nobody was in the car, and it was parked when it got hit. Is there anything I should do about the damage right now, like moving the car or getting it photographed?

Thanks, it's good that nobody was hurt. If you can do it safely, photos of the damage and the area around the car are useful to keep for the claims consultant. I can't tell you whether to move or drive the car, but if you're not sure it's safe to drive, I can arrange a tow. To get started, could you give me your policy number, or your date of birth and mobile number?

I've got the policy number: WTL456790. My date of birth is 14 March 1988, and my mobile is 0412 555 019. The car's fine to drive, by the way. It's a RAV4, and it's only a scrape on the rear passenger side. I'll take some photos tonight.

Thanks, Tom, you're verified. I can see your 2022 Toyota RAV4, rego 789XYZ, and I've noted it was parked, nobody was in it, there's a scrape on the rear passenger side, and you've said it's fine to drive. Which night did this happen, and roughly what time?
Monday night, around 9pm, on Main St in Kangaroo Point.
I've got that as Monday 26 October at around 9pm, on Main St, Kangaroo Point. Did you report it to the police, and if so, do you have a reference number?
No, I didn't report it to the police. It was a hit-and-run, and I didn't think they'd do much about a scrape. I don't have a reference number. Do I need one for the claim?

You don't need a police reference to lodge the claim, and the claims consultant will let you know if anything else is needed. Here's what I've got:

- Car (rego): 789XYZ
- Type of incident: hit while parked
- When: Monday 26 October 2026, around 9pm
- Where: Main St, Kangaroo Point
- What happened: Car was parked with nobody in it. Someone sideswiped it and took off (hit-and-run). Scrape on the rear passenger side.
- Can be driven safely: yes
- Who was driving: not given (the car was parked)
- Other party: unknown, the driver left the scene
- Police reference: not reported to police

Is all of that correct?
